content:
oncall-tim: Deploy-bot flagged a high-error spike in embedder service (eu-west1). Root cause looks like KV cache indexing regression in v2.1.3. I started a build for v2.1.4 with a quick fix. Need expedited approval to skip the 10m canary and push a hotfix.

deploy-bot: HOTFIX REQUEST: service=embedder region=eu-west1 image=embedder:v2.1.4-hotfix-kvcache trigger=alert-embed-5xx

alex-k: Details? how reproducible is the 5xx? :eyes: 

oncall-tim: Repro on 3/5 synthetic threads, production noise ~5% traffic leading to 5xx decoder errors. Patch fixes index key off-by-one in kv-lookup. Build done, image ready.

loren: I reviewed the diff. small and scoped. Approve from SRE side for expedited roll, but we need explicit rollback criteria and notify support.

maya: Security ok for image (scanned). No secret access changes. +1 for fastpatch.

jae: Product: thumbs up. Need a one-line release note and I'll update status page post-deploy.

eng-lead-janet: I am OK to skip canary for eu-west1 only. Conditions: must not exceed rollback triggers. I sign off.

oncall-tim: Rollback criteria proposed:
- sustained 5xx rate > 1% for 3 consecutive minutes
- p95 latency increase > 300ms from baseline for 5 minutes
- error spike correlated with the new image logs containing "kv-index-fail"

loren: add: automatic traffic cutback if node failure count > 2 in 2 mins. Also ensure prefix KV cache invalidation run after deploy.

eng-lead-janet: also require post-deploy smoke tests pass: "embedder-quick-check" (script) and manual sample queries.

jae: Release note draft: "embedder: fix KV cache indexing bug causing 5xx for some requests; improves stability in eu-west1." Keep it short.

oncall-tim: Noted. Notify support and ops channels on rollout start. Slack ping to #support in 1 minute.

alex-k: I give formal approval: +1 expedited. tagging @loren @maya @eng-lead-janet :white_check_mark:

loren: +1
maya: +1
eng-lead-janet: +1 — go for it.

deploy-bot: APPROVALS RECEIVED (4). Executing deploy: image=embedder:v2.1.4-hotfix-kvcache region=eu-west1 skip_canary=true rollout_strategy=immediate

deploy-bot: Step 1/4: drain old pods -> OK

deploy-bot: Step 2/4: apply image -> OK

deploy-bot: Step 3/4: run smoke checks: running `./tools/embedder-quick-check --region eu-west1`

oncall-tim: running smoke now.

oncall-tim: smoke output: PASS x 10 sample queries, no 5xx seen. Logs show kv-index fix applied.

deploy-bot: Step 3/4: smoke checks -> PASS

deploy-bot: Step 4/4: finalize rollout -> 100% traffic

deploy-bot: Rollout complete for eu-west1. Telemetry: 5xx back to baseline, p95 latency stable.

oncall-tim: Confirming support notified and status page updated. Added a postmortem stub link in the ticket: https://pm.internal/RED-1234

jae: Updating release notes and prod status. Thanks everyone.

loren: Leaving a follow-up: schedule a quick post-deploy verification at +15m and check cross-region spillover.

eng-lead-janet: Great response. Marking the incident as mitigated. We'll follow up with a brief RCA after logs collect.

deploy-bot: AUTO: deployment completed by expedited flow. If rollback needed, use `/deploy rollback embedder eu-west1 embedder:v2.1.3`.

alex-k: nice work. :rocket:
